policy: Failures and limits are published as loudly as successes. Entries are append-only; a retraction never deletes, it engraves.

entries.title: Sky engine cross-validated against PyEphem
entries.detail: Geocentric tropical longitudes compared for 2026-08-26 10:57 UT. All five planets within 0.10 deg of ephem 4.2.1; Sun exact to 0.01 deg; Moon within 0.36 deg (truncated lunar theory).

entries.title: Python Zij and browser clock agree to float tolerance
entries.detail: Same algorithms ported to Python (services/sky_engine.py) and JavaScript (web/ephemeris.js). Sidereal longitudes agree within 5e-7 deg across three timestamps (2000, 2026, 2030).

entries.title: Keplerian element window is 1800-2050
entries.detail: JPL approximate elements are fitted for 1800-2050. Zij rows outside that window are stamped tier=extrapolated and must never be presented as measured.

entries.title: Ayanamsa is an approximation
entries.detail: Lahiri (Chitrapaksha) ayanamsa uses a linear approximation (23.85306 deg at J2000 + 0.013966 deg/yr). Error is arcminute-level 1950-2050; every payload carries ayanamsa_err_arcmin=2.0.

entries.title: Moon longitude from a truncated series
entries.detail: Schlyter's truncated lunar theory (12 perturbation terms) was within 0.36 deg of PyEphem at the validation instant; treat up to ~0.4 deg as the working error bar until the Swiss-Ephemeris engine (A1) replaces it.

entries.title: Crescent classification is hypothesis-under-trial
entries.detail: The Yallop (1997) q-criterion is implemented as commonly published, but the implementation has NOT been verified against the original HM Nautical Almanac Office tables. Raw observables (altitudes, ARCL, ARCV, lag) are measured; the A-F band is hypothesis.

entries.title: Tabular calendars can differ from observed ones by a day
entries.detail: Hijri is tabular (30-year cycle, epoch JD 1948440.5): +-1 day vs local moon-sighting. Jalali is Birashk tabular: +-1 day vs the astronomical equinox calendar. Vikram Samvat uses the solar-year convention with the sa-kranti approximated to 14 April.

entries.title: Clock display compresses radii; angles are never altered
entries.detail: The Spacetime Clock compresses orbit radii (r^0.45) and enlarges the Moon's orbit for legibility; the spacetime fabric is schematic. All displayed angles are true geocentric sidereal longitudes. Disclosed in the page footer.

entries.title: Drishti chords exclude Rahu/Ketu
entries.detail: R-2.13's aspect table covers the seven classical grahas. The engine computes no Rahu/Ketu drishti and draws no chords for them, rather than inventing doctrine.

entries.title: No retractions on record
entries.detail: The retraction schema exists and is empty. When a finding is withdrawn, it is engraved here with its evidence and its replacement - never deleted.

entries.title: No pre-registrations on record
entries.detail: The pre-registration schema exists and is empty. A pre-registered claim must state: the rule, the exact computed predicate, the scoring window, the scoring script hash, and the adjudicator - before the outcome exists.
